kind: pre-registration; two-arm packages rebuilt and verified; submission slot scheduled 2026-09-23 for RM_LP

lineage.note: both arms rebuilt locally on this machine; NOT the /home/lux1/noise/ packages described by results/rematch_submission_registry.csv

existing_platform_scores.note: two distinct full-FT variants land within 0.08pp on the platform; locally LT has the HIGHER macro (71.8655 vs 71.8054), so the local ordering is again reversed on the platform

finding_1_val_is_iid_sample_of_train_poo.method: width/height columns already present in train_dev.csv and val_dev.csv; no image was read
finding_1_val_is_iid_sample_of_train_poo.conclusion: val is a faithful iid sample of the training pool at every slice, including the test-like geometry slice; therefore NO local re-slicing can build a cross-source proxy, and the 11.90pp local/platform gap is structurally invisible to any metric computed on val
consequences: refutes the leave-one-source-out proposal on the rematch data: there is only one source pool, so there is no source to leave out
closes the line of work that tries to explain the 11.90pp gap locally

finding_2_two_arms_are_genuinely_differe.method: per-image comparison of the two pred_results.csv over 37444 test images
finding_2_two_arms_are_genuinely_differe.conclusion: the experiment is well powered; the two arms give different answers on 28.72% of test images, so the platform scores can differ by several pp

finding_3_FT_gain_is_uniform_not_head_co.method: per_class blocks of logs/evaluation_epoch_20.json (RM_LP) and logs/evaluation_epoch_8.json (RM_FT); no inference was run
finding_3_FT_gain_is_uniform_not_head_co.conclusion: FT's in-pool gain is uniform across the support spectrum, so the hypothesis 'FT only fits head-class pool idiosyncrasies' is REFUTED; however a uniform in-pool gain is still ambiguous between 'better representation (transfers)' and 'more thorough fit of the same source domain (does not transfer)', which local data cannot separate

preregistered_criterion.statistic: transfer ratio = platform accuracy / local val micro; this controls for RM_LP's in-pool ceiling being 9.23pp below RM_FT's
preregistered_criterion.threshold_derivation: LP local micro 0.6363575458526611 x 0.8375 (the higher of the two FT-family transfer ratios)

bands.verdict: FT's in-pool advantage does not transfer at all; the test ceiling is set by the source
bands.action: spend the remaining 2-3 weeks entirely on domain robustness; stop producing FT variants

bands.verdict: frozen features transfer BETTER; part of FT's gain is pool-specific
bands.action: consider freezing more of the backbone (partial fine-tuning)

bands.verdict: FT's advantage transfers proportionally; the FT family remains correct
bands.action: look for robustness levers on top of FT

preregistered_criterion.reference_point: if the absolute 11.90pp gap applied unchanged, RM_LP would land at 51.73% (third band)
